';

      const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
      const els = {
        reader: $('reader'), page: $('page'), stage: $('stage'), title: $('top-title'), topProgress: $('top-progress'),
        fill: $('progress-fill'), footerPage: $('footer-page'), prev: $('prev'), next: $('next'), footerPrev: $('footer-prev'), footerNext: $('footer-next'),
        tocBackdrop: $('toc-backdrop'), toc: $('toc'), tocList: $('toc-list'), tocOpen: $('toc-open'), tocClose: $('toc-close'), theme: $('theme-toggle')
      };
      let book = null;
      let pageIndex = 0;
      let locked = false;
      let touchStart = null;


      const STORAGE_KEY = 'last-dance-reader-v1';
      function loadPrefs() {
        try {
          const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
          if (!raw) return { pageIndex: 0, highContrast: false };
          const data = JSON.parse(raw);
          return {
            pageIndex: Number.isFinite(data.pageIndex) ? data.pageIndex : 0,
            highContrast: !!data.highContrast
          };
        } catch (e) {
          return { pageIndex: 0, highContrast: false };
        }
      }
      function savePrefs() {
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify({
            pageIndex,
            highContrast: document.body.classList.contains('high-contrast')
          }));
        } catch (e) {}
      }
      (function restoreThemeEarly() {
        ent, tag, text, className) {
        const node = document.createElement(tag);
        if (className) node.className = className;
        node.textContent = text || '';
        parent.append(node);
        return node;
      }

      function renderCover() {
        els.page.className = 'page is-cover';
        els.page.replaceChildren();
        const cover = document.createElement('div'); cover.className = 'cover';
        const ornament = document.createElement('div'); ornament.className = 'cover-ornament'; ornament.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); cover.append(ornament);
        addText(cover, 'p', book.subtitle || '', 'cover-kicker');
        addText(cover, 'h1', book.title, 'cover-title');
        const rule = document.createElement('div'); rule.className = 'cover-rule'; rule.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); cover.append(rule);
        addText(cover, 'p', book.author ? 'by ' + book.author : '', 'cover-author');
        addText(cover, 'p', `${book.chapters.length} chapters`, 'cover-note');
        const begin = addText(cover, 'button', 'Begin reading', 'cover-cta');
        begin.type = 'button'; begin.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(1));
        addText(cover, 'p', 'Use ← →, Page Up/Down, Home/End, or swipe to turn pages.', 'cover-hint');
        els.page.append(cover);
      }

      function renderChapter(chapter) {
        els.page.className = 'page is-chapter';
        els.page.replaceChildren();
        const wrap = document.createElement('div'); wrap.className = 'chapter';
        const head = document.createElement('header'); head.className = 'chapter-head';
        addText(head, 'p', `Chapter ${chapter.number}`, 'chapter-label');
        addText(head, 'h1', chapter.title, 'chapter-title');
        const meta = [chapter.pov, chapter.date].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
        if (meta) addText(head, 'p', meta, 'chapter-meta');
        wrap.append(head);
        const body = document.createElement('div'); body.className = 'chapter-body';
        (chapter.paragraphs || []).forEach((paragraph, i) => {
          const p = document.createElement('p');
          if (i === 0) p.className = 'first-paragraph';
          p.append(inlineMarkup(paragraph)); body.append(p);
        });
        wrap.append(body);
        addText(wrap, 'p', '◆', 'chapter-end');
        els.page.append(wrap);
      }

      function render() {
        if (!book) return;
        if (pageIndex === 0) renderCover(); else renderChapter(book.chapters[pageIndex - 1]);
        const total = book.chapters.length + 1;
        const percent = total === 1 ? 0 : Math.round(pageIndex / (total - 1) * 100);
        els.title.textContent = book.title;
        els.topProgress.textContent = pageIndex === 0 ? `Cover · ${percent}%` : `Chapter ${book.chapters[pageIndex - 1].number} of ${book.chapters.length} · ${percent}%`;
        els.fill.style.width = percent + '%';
        els.footerPage.textContent = `${pageIndex + 1} / ${total}`;
        [els.prev, els.footerPrev].forEach(b => b.disabled = pageIndex === 0);
        [els.next, els.footerNext].forEach(b => b.disabled = pageIndex === total - 1);
        els.page.scrollTop = 0;
        document.title = pageIndex === 0 ? book.title : `${book.chapters[pageIndex - 1].title} — ${book.title}`;
        buildToc();
      }

      function goTo(target) {
        if (!book || locked) return;
        const max = book.chapters.length;
        const next = Math.max(0, Math.min(max, target));
        if (next === pageIndex) return;
        locked = true;
        els.stage.classList.remove('turn-next', 'turn-prev');
        void els.stage.offsetWidth;
        els.stage.classList.add(next > pageIndex ? 'turn-next' : 'turn-prev');
        window.setTimeout(() => {
          pageIndex = next; render(); locked = false;
          els.page.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        }, 220);
      }

      function buildToc() {
        if (!book) return;
        els.tocList.replaceChildren();
        const items = [{ number: '—', title: 'Cover', meta: book.subtitle || '', page: 0 }].concat(book.chapters.map(ch => ({ number: ch.number, title: ch.title, meta: [ch.pov, ch.date].filter(Boolean).join(' · '), page: ch.number })));
        items.forEach(item => {
          const button = document.createElement('button'); button.type = 'button'; button.className = 'toc-item' + (item.page === pageIndex ? ' is-active' : '');
          const number = addText(button, 'span', item.number, 'toc-num');
          const text = document.createElement('span');
          addText(text, 'strong', item.title);
          if (item.meta) addText(text, 'em', item.meta);
          button.append(text); button.addEventListener('click', () => { closeToc(); goTo(item.page); }); els.tocList.append(button);
        });
      }

      function openToc() { els.tocBackdrop.hidden = false; els.tocOpen.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true'); els.tocClose.focus(); }
      function closeToc() { els.tocBackdrop.hidden = true; els.tocOpen.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'); els.tocOpen.focus(); }

      async function decodeChunks() {
        const parts = [];
        const batchSize = 8;
        for (let start = 0; start < CHUNK_COUNT; start += batchSize) {
          const slice = Array.from({ length: Math.min(batchSize, CHUNK_COUNT - start) }, (_, j) => start + j);
          const responses = await Promise.all(slice.map(i => fetch(`${CHUNK_BASE}${String(i).padStart(3, '0')}.txt`, { cache: 'force-cache' })));
          const failed = responses.findIndex(r => !r.ok);
          if (failed !== -1) throw new Error(`Payload chunk ${String(slice[failed]).padStart(3, '0')} failed (${responses[failed].status})`);
          parts.push(...(await Promise.all(responses.map(r => r.text()))));
          els.topProgress.textContent = `Loading book… ${Math.min(start + batchSize, CHUNK_COUNT)}/${CHUNK_COUNT}`;
        }
        const b64 = parts.join('').replace(/\s/g, '');
        const binary = atob(b64); const bytes = Uint8Array.from(binary, c => c.charCodeAt(0));
        if (!('DecompressionStream' in window)) throw new Error('This browser cannot decompress the reader payload');
        const stream = new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('gzip'));
        return JSON.parse(await new Response(stream).text());
      }

      async function loadEmbedded() {
        const binary = atob(EMBEDDED_BOOK_GZ_B64);
        const bytes = Uint8Array.from(binary, c => c.charCodeAt(0));
        if (!('DecompressionStream' in window)) throw new Error('This browser cannot decompress the reader payload');
        const stream = new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('gzip'));
        return JSON.parse(await new Response(stream).text());
      }
      async function loadBook() {
        try {
          if (typeof EMBEDDED_BOOK_GZ_B64 === 'string' && EMBEDDED_BOOK_GZ_B64.length > 100) {
            book = await loadEmbedded();
          } else {
            throw new Error('no embed');
          }
        } catch (embedError) {
          try {
            let response = await fetch('./book.json', { cache: 'no-cache' });
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error('local book.json unavailable');
            book = await response.json();
          } catch (localError) {
            try { book = await decodeChunks(); }
            catch (chunkError) {
              throw new Error('Could not load the book (embed/local/chunks all failed).');
            }
          }
        }
        if (!book || !Array.isArray(book.chapters) || book.chapters.length !== 32) throw new Error('Book data is incomplete: expected 32 chapters.');
        render();
      }

      els.prev.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(pageIndex - 1)); els.next.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(pageIndex + 1));
      els.footerPrev.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(pageIndex - 1)); els.footerNext.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(pageIndex + 1));
      els.tocOpen.addEventListener('click', openToc
